take_homes: Access and absorption are different numbers. Our licence count tells the board about access only.
A new tool competes with what the person already uses, so ask what would have to be true for them to switch.
Start with one person and one conversation before buying or building anything.

monday.move: Ask my controller how she writes the month-end variance commentary today, and what would make her trust an agent draft. Then pick one test.
monday.stop_condition: If she says she'd never rely on it for finance data, or IT confirms it can't be used on finance data, I stop and don't build anything.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data. I also still have no cost per user per month to take to the CEO.

misconception.why: The line that access and absorption are two different numbers made me see that our licence rollouts only measured access. I'm not fully changed. I still think of it as something we buy, and the module never gave me a cost or payback.

one_line: Useful on why tools bought don't get used and on starting with one person, but there was no cost, no payback and no number I could take to the board, and the generic 'context' slides were filler.
